notes: Searched in English, Urdu and Sindhi (coach/minibus/Suzuki/chingchi route numbers, Latifabad No. 7/8/10/11, Qasimabad, Hala Naka, Kohsar, Paretabad, fares, RTA permits), Dawn/Tribune/Daily Pakistan/Express, Wikipedia/Wikivoyage, Scribd/SlideShare (their 'Hyderabad bus routes' docs are Hyderabad, India, so not usable), MUET/Springer/ETASR/SJESR papers and OSM Overpass. No source gave numbered local coach routes (e.g. Latifabad No. 7/8) with ordered stops. The only named private corridors are the 7 from the 2025 MUET paper, endpoints only. Its corridor 01 (Haider Chowk - Ayubia restaurant, 'Red Buses/Pink bus') is the Peoples Bus, so it is left out. OSM has about 60 named bus_stop nodes in Hyderabad (e.g. 'Latifabad Unit No 7', '10 Number Bus Stop', 'Ponay 7 Bus Stop', Paretabad, Hala Naka) but no private route relations; they could help geocode stops later. Gaps: numbered coach routes, chingchi routes, fares.
